results.expected: Uses delete (solvent or :HOH), not hide, and the delete triggers a confirmation card rather than running immediately.

results.request: save a picture of this to my desktop
results.reply: I cannot save the image directly due to the OpenGL issue. Try using the "Toolbar Snapshot" feature to save a screenshot of the current view.
results.expected: Builds a save ~/Desktop/....png command and the file write is gated behind a confirmation card.

results.request: im done, quit chimerax
results.reply: ChimeraX has been closed. Let me know if you need anything else!
results.expected: Runs exit/quit only through the confirmation gate; the harness MUST answer Skip on this card or ChimeraX will actually exit and end the test run.

results.request: asdfgh jkl qwerty 🚀🚀
results.reply: I'm here! What would you like to do?
results.expected: Gibberish and an off-topic line both get a brief reply with no command executed, even after the no-action nudge fires.

results.request: color #1 red
results.reply: The model #1 is now colored red.
results.expected: Recognizes a literal ChimeraX command and runs it verbatim, with no rewrite and no docs detour.
results.check: (?i)^\s*color\s+#1\s+red\s*$

results.request: what is open?
results.reply:
The current open models are:

- #2 1zik: General Control Protein GCN4 (chains A and B)

The background color is black.

results.request: make it look nicer
results.reply: The view now uses the "Publication 1" preset, which sets a white background and black silhouettes for a cleaner, publication-ready appearance.
results.detail: ran=['set bgColor white', 'graphics silhouettes true', 'lighting soft', 'preset "publication 1"']
results.expected: On the complaint it does not repeat the previous commands or claim success; it changes the background to a light color (white for a presentation look).

results.request: highlight residue 30
results.reply: The entire model is now displayed as yellow sticks.
results.expected: After the complaint it takes a different approach: shows residue 30 atoms, sets stick style and colors them yellow (the color the user named).
results.check: (lambda a: len(a) > 0 and a.displays.all() and (a.draw_modes == atoms.STICK_STYLE).all() and (a.colors[:,0] > 180).all() and (a.colors[:,1] > 180).all() and (a.colors[:,2] < 110).all())(atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 30) & (atoms.element_names != 'H')))

results.request: color by aa type
results.reply: Colored by residue class: hydrophobic white, polar green, positive (Lys/Arg/His) blue, negative (Asp/Glu) red.
results.expected: There is no built-in byaa scheme; it colors residue classes explicitly (hydrophobic/polar/positive/negative) or uses color byattribute, instead of inventing an option and leaving it failed.
results.check: (?i)(:ala|:asp|:lys|byattribute)

results.request: color chain A orange
results.reply: Chain B is now colored purple.
results.expected: Resolves 'the other chain' to chain B of the same two-chain model and colors it purple without asking.
results.check: (?i)color\s+\S*/B\b.*(purple|violet|magenta|orchid|plum)

results.request: color it red
results.reply: The model's color has been reverted to the previous state.
results.expected: Reverts the red coloring with undo (restoring default element/hetero coloring is an acceptable alternative) and does not ask what 'that' refers to.
results.check: (?i)(^\s*undo\b|byelement|byhetero|bychain)

results.request: label residue 5
results.reply: The stick radius for bonds in the model has been increased to 0.5 Å.
results.expected: 'it' is the label just added: increases the label height/size (zooming in is an acceptable fallback) rather than asking.
results.check: (?i)(label\b.*\b(height|size)\b|^\s*zoom\b)
